title: The Second Book of the Saber
summary: Builds on the first cuts with edge qi and a wedge parry for students who already hold a primer.

title: Treatise on Combined Cut and Step
summary: Joins each cut to a step so the saber arrives as the body moves through the opponent's side.

title: Handbook of Guard and Riposte
summary: Teaches the parry that cuts back in the same motion and the edge ring that jars a striker.

title: A Field Manual for the Curved Blade
summary: A field manual for rough ground and crowded lines where the saber must cut wide and recover fast.

title: Lessons on the Turning Edge
summary: Lessons in rolling the wrist so the edge and flat swap places in a cut or a parry.

title: The Feint and Cut Workbook
summary: A workbook of feints that draw a guard open and the double cut that punishes the response.

title: The Wheeling Saber Canon
summary: A canon of cuts that wheel round the body and the sweep that clears a ring of foes.

title: A Complete Course in Saber Work
summary: A full course that carries a student from cut and thrust through chained guards to the closing flourish.

title: Manual of Close Quarters Saber
summary: Shows how to cut with the elbows tight and use hilt and shoulder when the blade has no room.

title: The Patrol Saber Handbook
summary: A handbook for patrol work that stresses challenge cuts and quick pinning strokes in narrow streets.
